enemy-082-albino-pale-crucible-hunter.designLock: PROJECT_ADAPTATION systemic albino derivative of the reviewed enemy-030 Pale Crucible Hunter. Preserve one gaunt forge-born bipedal project xeno hunter with one eyeless elongated cranium, sick ivory exoskeletal plates over wet charcoal muscle seams, crucible-forged dorsal spines, narrow ribbed torso, exactly two very long sinewy forearms with dark claws, exactly two digitigrade legs and one complete long segmented tail. Albino changes newly authored pigment/material response only: increase the warm pearl/parchment translucency of the existing pale plates, shift wet seams toward cool ash-gray with restrained rose-taupe subsurface joints, retain dark smoked claws and deep recess contrast, and avoid a flat-white silhouette. The already-pale base anatomy, cranial length, dorsal-spine topology, gaunt proportions, limb count, tail, strict right-facing side view and project scale remain invariant. No eyes, clothing, equipment, armor, weapon, generic Warrior redesign, four Warrior dorsal tubes, royal crest, quadruped body, glow, snow/ice, copied predecessor pixels, official-model claim or 1:1 claim. Every future pixel is newly authored project art; canonExact=false.

designDetails.silhouette: Gaunt narrow biped with elongated eyeless cranium, narrow ribbed torso, crucible dorsal spines, two exceptionally long forearms, two digitigrade legs and one complete segmented tail.
designDetails.palette: Warm translucent pearl/parchment and bleached ivory plates over cool ash-gray wet seams, restrained rose-taupe joints, dark smoked claws and deep non-glowing recess contrast. Never flat white or icy blue.
designDetails.anatomy: One elongated eyeless head, narrow ribbed torso, crucible-forged dorsal spines, exactly two arms, two legs and one tail. No equipment and no generic Warrior tube array.
designDetails.separation: The Albino modifier is intentionally subtle because enemy-030 is already pale. Separation must come from material response and value/subsurface contrast only, never new anatomy, silhouette, glow or an ice theme.
designDetails.orientation: Strict right-facing orthographic gameplay profile. Cranium, claws, both feet, dorsal spines and complete tail remain inside every cell with generous gutters.
designDetails.root: New art requires 32 independent pelvis/proximal-leg-to-support-foot or terminal-body-plane anchors. Cranium tip, spine/tail extrema, bounds center and inherited enemy-030 coordinates are forbidden root proxies.
designDetails.scale: New art requires independent inter-clip calibration using rigid cranial length plus shoulder-to-pelvis landmarks. Do not inherit enemy-030 numeric factors or measure forearm/tail/action extrema.
designDetails.background: True alpha or perfectly uniform #FF00FF only; no Crucible room, forge, floor, cast shadow, checkerboard, grid, text, logo or UI.

actionLocks.idle: Eight grounded gaunt breathing/alert phases with restrained cranium, rib, spine-base and tail-base motion; both feet retain support.
actionLocks.move: Eight complete bipedal digitigrade gait phases with contact, passing, extension and recovery; long forearms counterbalance without becoming extra legs.
actionLocks.attack: Eight chronological claw or inner-jaw strike phases: anticipation, wind-up, extension into empty space, one contact posture, follow-through and recovery; no weapon or detached effect.
actionLocks.death: Lethal reaction, biped support loss, gaunt collapse and terminal motionless body; cranium, dorsal spines, limbs and tail remain attached.
